questions.question: After make_feature_extractor(num_classes=10), which parameters are intended to receive gradients?
options: The replacement classifier head only
Every convolution and the old ImageNet classifier
Only BatchNorm running statistics
No parameters, because the model is in eval mode
questions.explanation: The function freezes the pretrained parameters, then replaces fc with a new trainable Linear layer for the target classes.

questions.question: How does make_fine_tune differ from make_feature_extractor?
options: It removes every convolution and keeps only the old head
It leaves the pretrained backbone parameters trainable after replacing fc
It freezes the new classifier and changes images to grayscale
It skips ImageNet normalization
questions.explanation: Fine-tuning creates the same kind of new classifier but sets requires_grad=True for all model parameters.

questions.question: In discriminative_param_groups, which stage receives the largest learning rate when decay=0.3?
options: conv1 and bn1
layer1
The new fc head
All stages receive exactly the same rate
questions.explanation: The exponent is zero for the last stage, fc, so it keeps base_lr; earlier backbone stages receive progressively smaller rates.

questions.question: Why can freeze_bn_stats help when fine-tuning on a tiny dataset?
options: It turns every convolution into a linear classifier
It increases the learning rate of the earliest layers
It removes the classifier head from the optimizer
It prevents small batches from replacing pretrained BatchNorm running statistics
questions.explanation: The helper puts BatchNorm modules in eval mode and freezes their affine parameters, avoiding noisy running-stat updates.

questions.question: What preprocessing does ArrayDataset apply before returning a training example?
options: Subtract ImageNet channel means, divide by standard deviations, then permute HWC to CHW
Convert every image to a single grayscale byte
Resize labels and leave pixels in HWC order
Apply a random crop after converting the label to a tensor
questions.explanation: The dataset uses the declared ImageNet mean/std arrays and returns a float tensor with channels first.

questions.question: A fine-tuning run has feature drift after unfreezing the backbone. Which first change matches the lesson's diagnosis?
options: Increase the backbone rate far above the head rate
Lower the backbone learning rates while keeping a larger rate for the new head
Replace cross-entropy with a pixel-wise mask loss
Disable the validation loop so drift cannot be measured
questions.explanation: Discriminative rates protect generic early features from large updates while allowing the task-specific head to adapt quickly.
